name: perbowl-pet-food-recalls
title: US Dog and Cat Food Recalls (FDA, 2012 onward)
description: Every dog and cat food recall the US FDA has classified since 8 June 2012, with products, barcodes, lot codes, reason categories and reviewed links to brands, makers and plants.

resources.name: recalls
resources.title: Recalls
resources.description: One row per recall event: a firm's recall of one or more products, as FDA classified it.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: FDA recall event number (Enforcement Report). Joins every file.

fields.name: classified_date
fields.description: Date FDA classified the recall (earliest across its products).

fields.name: initiated_date
fields.description: Date the firm started the recall (earliest across its products), from FDA's Enforcement Report.

fields.name: terminated_date
fields.description: Date FDA ended the recall: the latest product termination, filled only once every product is terminated.

fields.name: fda_class
fields.description: Class I (most serious), Class II or Class III.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Active if any product is still ongoing at FDA, else Closed.

fields.name: firm
fields.description: Recalling firm, as FDA records it.

fields.name: firm_city
fields.description: Recalling firm's city (FDA).

fields.name: firm_state
fields.description: Recalling firm's state (FDA).

fields.name: species
fields.description: dog, cat or both (dog;cat), from the product descriptions. Empty when no product names either.

fields.name: reason_category
fields.description: PerBowl's category for the reason, e.g. Salmonella, Excess vitamin D. Several are joined with ";".

fields.name: reason_text
fields.description: FDA's reason for recall, verbatim.

fields.name: distribution
fields.description: FDA's distribution pattern, verbatim (shortened to 400 characters).

fields.name: product_count
fields.description: Number of product rows in products.csv for this event.

fields.name: maker
fields.description: The pet food maker this recall is linked to. Empty unless the link has evidence.

fields.name: maker_evidence
fields.description: name = the recalling firm is that maker (reviewed name match); plant = same FDA facility number as one of its licensed plants.

fields.name: plant
fields.description: The licensed plant linked to this recall, if any, as "Maker, City, ST".

fields.name: plant_evidence
fields.description: fei = same FDA facility number; trace = a published investigation (see recall_traces.csv).

fields.name: maker_url
fields.description: The maker's page on PerBowl.

fields.name: plant_url
fields.description: The plant's page on PerBowl.

fields.name: brands
fields.description: Brands linked after a person read the product list (see recall_brands.csv). Joined with ";".

fields.name: fda_url
fields.description: FDA's record for the first product in the event.

fields.name: perbowl_url
fields.description: The recall's page on PerBowl.

resources.name: products
resources.title: Recalled products
resources.description: One row per recalled product in FDA's record.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: FDA recall event number.

fields.name: product_no
fields.description: Position of the product within its event (1, 2, ...).

fields.name: description
fields.description: FDA's product description, verbatim (shortened to 900 characters).

fields.name: upcs
fields.description: Barcodes (UPC/EAN) found in the description, digits only, joined with ";".

fields.name: lot_codes
fields.description: Lot codes, best-by dates and other codes from FDA's Enforcement Report "Code Info" field.

fields.name: fda_class
fields.description: Class I, II or III for this product.

fields.name: status
fields.description: FDA status for this product: Ongoing, Completed or Terminated.

fields.name: recall_number
fields.description: FDA recall number, e.g. V-166-2012 (V = veterinary).

fields.name: initiated_date
fields.description: Date the firm started this product's recall.

fields.name: report_date
fields.description: Date the recall appeared in FDA's weekly Enforcement Report.

fields.name: terminated_date
fields.description: Date FDA terminated this product's recall. Empty while it is open.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Amount of product recalled, as the firm reported it (units vary: cases, bags, pounds).

fields.name: voluntary
fields.description: FDA's voluntary or mandated field, verbatim.

fields.name: firm_notified_by
fields.description: How the firm first told its customers or the public (letter, telephone, press release, ...).

fields.name: fda_url
fields.description: FDA's record for this product.

resources.name: recall_brands
resources.title: Recall to brand links
resources.description: One row per brand a person confirmed in a recall's product list. A word match alone never makes a link.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: FDA recall event number.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Brand name on PerBowl.

fields.name: perbowl_url
fields.description: The brand's page on PerBowl.

resources.name: excluded
resources.title: Rows left out
resources.description: Every FDA veterinary recall row the dog-and-cat filter dropped, with the reason, so the filter can be checked.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: FDA recall event number.

fields.name: product_id
fields.description: FDA product number.

fields.name: classified_date
fields.description: Date FDA classified it.

fields.name: firm
fields.description: Recalling firm (FDA).

fields.name: description
fields.description: FDA's product description (shortened to 300 characters).

fields.name: excluded_because
fields.description: Why it is not in recalls.csv.

fields.name: fda_url
fields.description: FDA's record.

resources.name: recall_traces
resources.title: Recall to plant traces
resources.description: Plants named by a published investigation (for example a CDC report), not by FDA's recall record.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: FDA recall event number.

fields.name: plant
fields.description: The plant, as "Maker, City, ST".

fields.name: source_title
fields.description: The investigation that names the plant.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Where to read it.
